key_provisions_or_claims: Deletes 'In the case of category M1' from Annex XII B of Directive 70/156/EEC
Extends the end-of-series derogation to all vehicle categories
End-of-series vehicles capped at 10% of vehicles of the type put into service the previous year
Member States must comply before 1 October 1993
Commission to examine a definitive solution by 31 March 1994
annotation.summary_en: Commission Directive 93/81/EEC amends the type-approval Directive 70/156/EEC by extending the 'end-of-series' derogation, previously limited to category M1, to all motor vehicle categories, easing the impact of new diesel emission limits amid a market downturn. It is unrelated to AI or robotics.
